subject: Re: Follow-up: Compliance + vendor security next steps
messages:
From: Claire O'Neil <claire.oneil@healthbridge.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance discovery follow-up + vendor questionnaire

Thanks for the call this morning — useful overview of Redwood's serving modes. Quick recap from our side and a couple asks so we can move to procurement.

- Our security team needs: current SOC 2 status (type, date), evidence access model, GDPR data processing clarification, and any HIPAA responsibilities if PHI is in scope.
- We have an initial vendor security questionnaire (attached) — would you prefer to complete that or fill out your own template?
- Timeline: we aim to finish vendor assessments by end of Feb; procurement and budget approval follow.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will own the questionnaire and provide SOC artifacts? Also, any blockers for an on-prem/private deployment assessment (we likely need VPC or private deployment options for some workloads).

Thanks,
Claire
Claire O'Neil
Head of IT Risk | HealthBridge Medical Systems
claire.oneil@healthbridge.io | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neil <claire.oneil@healthbridge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance discovery follow-up + vendor questionnaire

Claire — thanks for the clear recap and for sharing the questionnaire (received). High-level responses and next steps below:

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in Oct 2025. I attached the SOC2 summary and the control scope (high level) for intake. If you need the full report, we can start an NDA/attestation exchange process — Monica will own that flow.

2) GDPR/HIPAA: We operate under a DPA and support data processing agreements; we also offer Private/VPC deployments and on-prem options for regulated data. HIPAA: Redwood can be configured in a way that supports HIPAA workloads (customer-managed keys, audit logging, private deployment). The exact responsibilities depend on deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private). We'll map responsibility matrix for each option.

3) Vendor questionnaire: Please use the attached XLS (the sheet you sent). Monica will coordinate the responses and tracker.

4) Timeline & owners: Monica Patel (cc'd) is our security/compliance lead for vendor intake and will be your primary. I'll stay looped for commercial/rollout items. Proposed timeline: questionnaire completed by 2026-01-29, SOC artifacts/attestation exchange by 2026-02-05, procurement-ready packet by 2026-02-12. Please confirm these dates.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx, SOC2_Type2_Summary_2025.pdf

Next steps: Monica to send the completed questionnaire and a short responsibility matrix; Ben to share HubSpot deal link and procurement checklist if helpful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0124
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neil <claire.oneil@healthbridge.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Compliance discovery follow-up + vendor questionnaire

Hi Claire — thanks, and hello. I'm attaching our completed questionnaire (tabbed), a one-page SOC 2 summary, and a network segmentation diagram showing private deployment options.

Quick notes inline for your security reviewers:
- SOC 2 scope: Availability, Security, Confidentiality. The Type II report covers the period Mar–Sep 2025.
- Access to artifacts: We provide a secure artifact portal for SOC reports and key evidence after an attestation or NDA and a short access request form.
- Data residency & GDPR: For hosted customers we offer region-specific tenancy; for stricter requirements, Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) keeps all model serving within your VPC.
- HIPAA-specific: Our recommended approach is Redwood Private with customer-managed KMS and audit log forwarding to your SIEM. We'll provide a responsibilities matrix showing which controls the customer must implement.

I've populated the vendor questionnaire (red highlights where we need clarification from you). Two asks from our side:
1) Clarify whether you intend to send PHI through the API or process it via private deployment only.
2) If you need a full SOC 2 report, please share an access NDA contact so we can provision artifact access.

Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx (completed), SOC2_Type2_Summary_2025.pdf, Network_Seg_Diagram.png

Happy to jump on a 30-minute tech/security call next week to walk through any redlines. Available windows: Tue 1/20 0900–1100 PST or Thu 1/22 1300–1600 PST.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0179

Monica/Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few quick points from our security review after scanning your answers:

- The SOC 2 summary addresses our initial questions; we'll request full artifacts if the attestation is provided. Please send the NDA contact.
- A few items in the questionnaire need clarifications (see red-highlighted cells): encryption-at-rest key management, multi-tenant isolation guarantees for hosted modes, and your patching cadence for inference nodes.
- For timeline: we can accept the proposed dates, but procurement will need the finalized questionnaire + artifact access by 2026-02-05 to meet our Feb cutoff.

We'd like to take the Thurs 1/22 14:00 PST slot for a 30-minute follow-up to go over the redlines and the private deployment architecture. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
